query_text: Audit the checkout modal accessibility tree and report controls whose roles or accessible names do not match their visible purpose.
Change three validator lines with a focused patch and avoid reformatting the neighboring module or touching unrelated helpers.
Rename a configuration key in the two required files using reviewable hunks that preserve all surrounding user edits.
Update the documented flag and its example with the smallest textual patch, leaving the rest of the guide byte-for-byte unchanged.
Insert one parser guard clause through a surgical diff and do not rewrite the function body merely to match personal style.
Verify that the documentation site starts successfully and that top navigation, search, and the version switcher are usable.
Close out the bug fix by naming changed files, fresh commands and results, plus any risk that the checks did not cover.
Write the final implementation summary with exact passing counts and observed behavior, without claiming unmeasured performance gains.
Report that one required check is blocked, include its exact failure, and distinguish completed evidence from remaining work.
Prepare a concise closeout that cites artifact hashes, repository status, validation output, and explicitly excluded actions.
Complete the multi-step account form with its country selector, birth date, profile upload, and final confirmation action.
Exercise checkout validation with missing fields, correct every reported error, and submit a test order through the browser.
Fill the feedback dialog, choose a rating, toggle consent, send the response, and confirm the success state appears.
Drive the signup flow using only the keyboard, select an autocomplete option, accept the terms, and submit the form.
Route a task that needs an existing signed-in web session, visible page inspection, several clicks, and a final screenshot.
Select the correct tool path for recalculating workbook formulas, adding a chart, and delivering a verified XLSX artifact.
Decide which available tools should inspect a local image and which should extract structured text from a separate PDF report.
Before editing the cross-file configuration system, clarify compatibility expectations and outline an implementation sequence with tests.
Requirements for the new authentication option are incomplete; ask the key questions and prepare a plan without changing files.
Break the storage migration into ordered steps, risks, rollback points, and validation criteria before implementation begins.
Produce a concise implementation plan for cache invalidation that names assumptions, touched modules, and observable success checks.
The user invoked the apply slash workflow for an active change; follow that lifecycle stage and preserve its stated boundaries.
Handle an explicit review command by loading its prescribed context, performing only the review, and returning the required verdict shape.
Run the requested archive slash procedure after checking completion evidence and use the command-specific validation sequence.
Respond to an explicit proposal slash command by creating the lifecycle artifacts while leaving implementation untouched.
As the assigned worker, implement only the parser subtask, run its focused tests, and hand back changed paths and caveats.
Reproduce the intermittent command-line crash, narrow the triggering input, and identify the failing layer before proposing a fix.
Trace the serialization test failure from observed bytes through the encoder and isolate the first incorrect transformation.
Assign independent API and interface investigations to separate agents, then compare their evidence before choosing the next step.
Distribute unrelated test and documentation audits to specialized subagents and collect concise handoffs from both streams.
Delegate codebase discovery and a separate risk audit, making each assignment read-only and bounded to a concrete deliverable.
Coordinate two workers on isolated components, review their outputs, and integrate only findings that match the shared acceptance criteria.
Add a parser option by writing a focused failing behavior test first, then implement only enough code to make it pass.
Capture the date parsing defect with a minimal regression test before changing the parser and cleaning up the solution.
Define the cache expiration behavior in tests before editing implementation details, then refactor only after the suite passes.
Create an isolated worktree for a concurrent feature so its branch and filesystem changes cannot collide with active work.
Move the risky refactor into a separate worktree based on the required commit and verify the directory starts clean.
Prepare a fresh worktree from the target branch, confirm its baseline identity, and keep the original checkout untouched.
Separate parallel fixes into distinct worktree directories and record which branch owns each isolated set of edits.
Confirm repository status and generated-file cleanliness immediately before claiming the build is complete and clean.
Recompute the artifact hash and row counts from disk, then compare them with the manifest before reporting success.
Inspect visual diffs for the data table at three breakpoints and flag column wrapping or control overlap introduced by the change.
Recover from a failed experiment without resetting or checking out over unrelated local files that belong to the user.
Inspect the filter panel semantics and determine whether grouped checkboxes expose useful names, states, and relationships.
Add the missing error case with a minimal patch and keep the existing function structure and unrelated lines intact.
Load the development blog in a browser and smoke-test article navigation, the theme toggle, and the home link.
Give the user a completion report grounded in fresh commands, exact results, file scope, and explicit non-actions.
Complete the event registration workflow, including attendee details, session choices, dietary notes, and confirmation.
Route a request that must inspect a CSV, create a verified spreadsheet, and avoid controlling a live desktop workbook.
Plan the addition of audit logging by identifying open requirements, data boundaries, implementation steps, and verification.
Execute the explicitly requested archive slash lifecycle and stop if its required validation state is not satisfied.
Work the delegated manifest-validation subtask, respect its file boundary, test it, and send a precise parent handoff.
Diagnose the nondeterministic ordering failure by reproducing it, controlling inputs, and finding the first source of variance.
Have one agent inspect data contracts and another inspect command behavior, then reconcile their independent findings.
Implement the new timeout rule by first proving a relevant test fails, then make that test pass with minimal code.
Isolate the release-line investigation in a new worktree at the specified base without disturbing the current checkout.
Validate the claimed fix from a clean state with fresh commands and inspect the evidence before announcing completion.
Compare the updated empty-state panel with its baseline across wide and narrow viewports, then report visible regressions.
Before modifying anything, verify repository identity, current status, branch ancestry, and the ownership of existing changes.
